title: balance.json logic_hz=10 contradicts ADR-2 (20Hz), the file's own comment, and is baked into the test
evidence:
game/data/balance.json:2  "_comment": "... logic_hz=20 -> 50ms/tick (ADR-2). ..."
game/data/balance.json:3  "logic_hz": 10,
architecture-v1.md:1327  1. **Logic tick rate — DECIDED: keep `LOGIC_HZ = 20`; premium feel is decoupled.**
game/tests/core/test_catalogs.gd:61  	eq(b.logic_hz, 10, "logic_hz == 10")
detail: logic_hz=10 contradicts ADR-2/Open-Q1 ('DECIDED: keep 20') and the file's own comment (logic_hz=20 -> 50ms/tick). The sim runs at 10Hz, doubling every tick-based duration (surge, grace, leads); test_catalogs asserts 10, so a correct fix fails the test.
recommended_fix: Set logic_hz to 20 in balance.json (per ADR-2) and update test_catalogs to assert 20; or, if 10 is intended, fix the stale comment and record the deviation against ADR-2/Open-Q1.

title: Keystone replay-equality test runs in a no-pipes topology — routing/traversal/QoS never execute
evidence:
test_replay.gd docstring: ## S0.2/S0.6 — replay-equality ... The determinism spine's keystone test.
test_replay.gd _step_n:  		snap = driver.step(state, i + 1, [])   # empty action log
_bootstrap calls RunState.bootstrap (run_state.gd places 6 spawn_node, NO DrawPipe)
test_replay.gd:49-50  # (Fingerprints can converge in the degenerate no-pipes case because the rng-
# dependent dst picks don't affect the drop aggregates, so rng state is the honest
# signal here.)
detail: The determinism spine's keystone test bootstraps with no pipes + empty action log, so every spawned packet drops 'unreachable' — routing, bandwidth traversal, and QoS lane-serving never run. Routing-level non-determinism would pass undetected.
recommended_fix: Have the replay test apply DrawPipeCmds to wire the MVP map into the action log before stepping, so the deterministic routing/traversal/QoS paths are exercised end-to-end — not just spawn+drop.
